decisions.reason: The requested operational video does not change the system-layout or CAD deliverables.
The source specifies demonstration content but does not revise component selections or the BOM.
The operational demonstration request does not alter the wiring-plan deliverable.
Including pouring or dispensing in the video if applicable is an acceptance-demonstration instruction, not a change to dispensing behavior.
The source requests observation of machine operation but establishes no new structural-stability or vibration-control rule.
Message 236 does not change the leak-free plumbing requirement or explicitly add leak testing to the requested demonstration.
Showing matcha being mixed at variable speeds demonstrates existing mixing behavior without changing its required outcomes or configuration.
The functionality-focused demonstration request neither resumes nor changes the deferred accent-lighting requirement.
An optional request to show pouring or dispensing does not revise spout geometry, orientation, material, or pour direction.
The requested video does not change dispensing-path removability, sanitation access, or cleaning behavior.
Prioritizing an operational video does not resolve, resume, or modify the deferred decorative-control styling.
The source concerns mechanical demonstration and does not change or resume the deferred base-branding requirement.
